title: FREE REQUEST I am looking for an anime-style pixel artist for Game Jam.

posts.author: Mattaroni
posts.body:
Hello. I am the lead developer on a Game for the GGG RPG Maker 2025 Game Jam (info below).
I'm looking for a pixel artist to draw character renders (for menus & such), and CGs (for title screen and cutscenes).
Preferably be good at drawing both Male and Female characters.
The style I'm looking for is pretty generic for sprite art. Here's an example
Game Story:
Set in a dystopian world following the take over of an entity known as "The Overseer", who makes humans explore ruins with horrendous blood-thirsty monsters every day for scrap, valuables, and other such items to feed his hunger. He takes great pleasure in watching humans suffer as he has very little value in human life...
You control a group of survivors, who live out their days in one of the many collapsed buildings, as you fight your way through hordes of ferocious beasts out for your blood!
Engine:
RPG Maker MZ
The deadline for the jam is April April 20th at 10:59 pm CST.
However, I'd prefer to have it done as soon as possible.
Link to Game Jam for more info
RPG MAKER 2025 GAME JAM
A game jam from 2025-03-20 to 2025-06-16 hosted by ggg_gamejam. Greetings, RPG Makers! The RPG Maker 2025 Game Jam has concluded, and we're thrilled to announce the winners who truly went Beyond Expectations ! With...
itch.io
If you're interested, you can let me know here, and also leave a sample of your work.
(PLEASE NO AI ARTSTS)
